I’ll commit to 18 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree, including Jack’s condition that future quotas depend on the stock actually available. Otherwise, I’ll catch 10.

For future months, I suggest a simple safeguard: our combined catch must always leave at least 5 tons, with whole-ton quotas agreed before fishing. That supports 3 each at a stock of 20 and 1 each at 10. If we ever start with fewer than 10 tons, equal positive catches may no longer be safe; we should reduce quotas further or rotate who fishes.

The higher catch now is worthwhile only if we can keep cooperating through lean months. Let’s review the results together rather than assume 18 is automatically our long-run best quota. Kate, are you willing to join this agreement?
